<h3>Cómo se lee el recuadro</h3><ul><li>:
How to read the box

  • ● green: online; ● orange: offline.
  • ✓ Ready: the copy is complete and it's the version you're using.
  • Blue bar: it's saving (the first time or a new version).
  • New version ready: it's already downloaded; «Update» opens it. If you don't update, it opens by itself next time you close and open the app.
  • «It can't be saved here»: you're in the claude.ai copy or in a browser without this feature.
<h3>Actualizaciones y espacio</h3><p cla:
Updates and space

Every time you open the game with internet it looks for a new version (and then every hour). It only downloads what changed: almost always the page, not the game data. Safari can delete copies of websites that haven't been opened for weeks: if one day the app asks for internet, open it online and wait for «Ready». «Delete the copy» frees the space.
el juego se guarda entero en el navegad: the whole game is saved in the browser; with «Share → Add to Home Screen» it becomes an app that works in airplane mode (everything except rooms with friends).
